name: evolution
description: Self-evolving skills: notices hard-won fixes, turns each into a new or updated versioned skill, tracks which skills actually fire, and prunes the ones that stop earning their keep.

nudge.title: Nudge mode
nudge.description: What happens when a session looks like a hard-won fix. auto: Claude is asked to evaluate it with evolution:capture before stopping. suggest: you get a one-line hint and decide. off: only explicit /evolution:capture.

struggle_threshold.title: Struggle threshold
struggle_threshold.description: Score at which a session counts as hard-won: each failed (non-probe) shell command scores 1, each 'still broken'-style correction from you scores 2.

stale_days.title: Stale after (days)
stale_days.description: An evolved skill becomes a prune candidate once it has gone this many days AND 20 sessions without being used.
